newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI KINDLUSTUS JUNE PREMIUMS UP BY 27PCT YR/YR.
newsitem.headline: EESTI KINDLUSTUS JUNE PREMIUMS UP BY 27PCT YR/YR.

text.p: Total collected premiums from the Eesti Kindlustus Group were 22.8 million kroons in June, the insurance group said on Wednesday.
In a statement the group said that the premiums collected in June were a 27 percent increase compared to the same period in 1996.
The biggest growth was recorded in legal entities' property insurance, up by 127 percent, life insurance by 49 percent and individuals' property insurance, up by 43 percent.
In June the group also started operating a 100 percent owned subsidiary, Eesti Elukindlustus, which has taken over all life insurance agreements together with the applicable reserves.
Eesti Kindlustus has also been made into a holding company and will begin to handle reinsurance risk, the group said in a statement.
The majority owner of Eesti Kindlustus is the second largest bank in Estonia, Hoiupank .
